title: Miles Expiry Panic
scenario: A message says your miles expire tonight unless you refresh activity through a link.

answers.A: Check the expiry date in the loyalty app.
answers.B: Click the link and buy something to keep the miles alive.
answers.C: Open the airline site yourself and review your miles activity.
answers.D: Ask a travel companion whether the message looks real.

explanation: Expiry panic is meant to rush you into a fake page or unnecessary purchase. Check the account directly before acting.
proTip: A genuine balance and expiry date are visible after you sign in normally.
